info.title: EnglishFlow API
info.description: REST API for the EnglishFlow vocabulary learning app. All successful responses are wrapped in `{ success, data, timestamp }` and all errors in `{ success: false, statusCode, message, error, errors?, path, timestamp }`.

onboardedAt.description: Null until the user completes or skips onboarding

emailVerifiedAt.description: Null until the user verifies their email

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT (default 15 min). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on authenticated requests.

refreshToken.description: Opaque long-lived refresh token (default 30 days). POST to /auth/refresh to rotate this into a new access + refresh pair when the access token expires.

password.description: Plain text password, hashed server-side with bcrypt. Must contain at least one letter and one digit.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token. Optional when the request carries the `refresh_token` httpOnly cookie (web clients).

token.description: The opaque password-reset token delivered by email.

newPassword.description: The new password. Must contain at least one letter and one digit.

token.description: The opaque email-verification token delivered by email.

email.description: New email address. Must be unique.

dailyGoal.description: Daily review goal (1–200). Editable without the current password.

currentPassword.description: The current password — required only when changing email, to prevent account takeover via stolen access tokens. Not needed for other updates (e.g. dailyGoal).

deckIds.description: Decks to enroll in. May be empty when the user skips.

newPassword.description: The new password. Must contain at least one letter and one digit.

currentPassword.description: The current password — required to confirm account deletion and prevent takeover-then-delete via a stolen access token.
